method: Incrementally retain every new image row, camera, exposure timestamp, day/night, source mapping and file existence; query backlog, config revision and service state; count new capture log errors with inode/offset and explicit rotation/truncation gaps. No production writes except the observation JSONL/log.
acceptance_requirements: At least 24 consecutive hours with both day and night; inspect all inter-frame intervals and sampling gaps.
Both cameras, source-only FITS publication/preview/export/generation, cleanup and five-day timelapse protection remain separate acceptance gates.
Do not count pre-existing failed tasks as newly observed failures.
Any acquisition or scheduling fix requires a new 24-hour period.
Read logs around any rotation gap or errors; a complete JSONL alone is not a pass verdict.
verification: Python compile passed; first real sample succeeded and process is alive.
